test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

To submit a report / on the recent fire accident, / a high level commitee / has been formed.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the spelling error in the word "**commitee**."
 
• The **correct spelling** should be "**committee**."
 
• The error is located in **segment 1** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"To submit a report on the recent fire accident, a high level **committee** has been formed."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Segment 2:** "has been formed" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Segment 3:** "To submit a report" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Segment 4:** "on the recent fire accident" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
